subject: general
question: When did Bangladesh emerge as an independent country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1971**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bangladesh emerged as an independent country in 1971** after a war of independence against Pakistan, known as the Bangladesh Liberation War.
 
• The war began on 26th March 1971 and concluded on 16th December 1971, when the Pakistani military surrendered to the allied forces of Bangladesh and India.
 
• Sheikh Mujibur Rahman is considered the founding leader of Bangladesh and served as its first President and later as Prime Minister.
 
• The independence of Bangladesh was officially recognized by various countries and international organizations soon after the victory in the war.
 
• The country has since then commemorated its independence on 26th March every year, known as Independence Day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The independence of Bangladesh was a result of a long-standing movement for autonomy and political rights within the region of East Pakistan.
 
• The cultural and linguistic differences between East and West Pakistan played a significant role in the demand for independence.
 
• Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and his party, the Awami League, led the movement for independence, culminating in the declaration of independence in March 1971.
 
• Bangladesh has since developed into a nation with a growing economy and has made significant progress in various sectors including education, health, and infrastructure.
 
• The country is also a member of international organizations such as the United Nations, the Commonwealth of Nations, and the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC).
